name: Plymouth
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Plymouth, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Plymouth, MA: the tree lighting, Light the Night at Brewster Gardens, a Polar Express night and an Elf pajama party at Plimoth Cinema.
lede: Plymouth opens the season with the town tree and menorah lighting on the Town Hall Green, then lights up Brewster Gardens with a free trail that glows every night in December. Kids can also ride the Polar Express story at the art center and watch Elf in pajamas at Plimoth Cinema.
celebrates: Christmas in Plymouth centers on the downtown waterfront. The Plymouth Downtown Waterfront District runs the Holiday Stroll, a three-day weekend that starts with the Town of Plymouth's Tree and Menorah Lighting on the Town Hall Green, brings Santa to Main Street for photos and ends with a ticketed Cookie Trail through local shops. Light the Night fills Brewster Gardens with festive displays all month. The Plymouth Center for the Arts hosts a Polar Express evening, Plimoth Patuxet Museums opens its villages by firelight and screens Elf at Plimoth Cinema, and the Plymouth Philharmonic plays its Hometown Holiday concerts at Memorial Hall with a March of the Toys parade of giving.
lastyear: In 2025 the Downtown Waterfront District held the Holiday Stroll from December 4 to 6, opening with the Town Tree Lighting on December 4, and Light the Night glowed in Brewster Gardens from December 4 to 31. The Plymouth Antiquarian Society staged A Christmas Carol at the Hedge House, a holiday show that returns this season and is already sold out. The Plymouth Philharmonic's annual holiday concerts ask families to bring an unwrapped gift for The March of the Toys, a parade of giving for the Children's Holiday Fund.
facts: Plymouth is where the Mayflower passengers settled in 1620, which is why the town calls itself America's Hometown. Plymouth Rock sits on the harbor in Pilgrim Memorial State Park, along Water Street downtown. By land area Plymouth is the largest town in Massachusetts, reaching from the downtown waterfront south to villages such as Manomet and Cedarville. Plimoth Patuxet Museums on Warren Avenue shows both a Wampanoag homesite and a 17th-century English village.
trains: The closest commuter rail stop is Kingston station, the last stop on the MBTA Kingston Line from South Station in Boston, in the next town north of Plymouth. Trains used to run into a Plymouth station too, but that stop closed in 2021. For a holiday train ride, Edaville in neighboring Carver runs its train through the Christmas lights each season, and Cape Cod Central Railroad runs trains from Hyannis. The Old Colony and Fall River Railroad Museum in Fall River keeps regional railroad history alive.

kidfact: Plymouth is the biggest town in Massachusetts by land, so big that it has its own villages inside it, like Manomet and Cedarville. The famous Plymouth Rock is right downtown by the harbor, where the Mayflower passengers came ashore.
faq: When is the Plymouth tree lighting?

The Town of Plymouth lights its tree and menorah on the Town Hall Green at 26 Court Street on the Friday that opens the Holiday Stroll in early December. The See Plymouth calendar lists the evening from 4 to 6 pm with the lighting at 5 pm, Santa visiting and live music, and it is free for families.
Is Light the Night in Plymouth free?

Yes. The Downtown Waterfront District calls Light the Night at Brewster Gardens a free, family friendly light trail that is open to the public. It opens with a lighting ceremony with Santa on the Saturday of the Holiday Stroll and stays lit every night from sundown to sunrise through December 31.
Where can kids see Santa in Plymouth?

Santa visits the Town Hall Green at the tree lighting, sits for photos on Main Street on the Saturday afternoon of the Holiday Stroll from 1 to 4 pm, and helps switch on Light the Night at Brewster Gardens at 5 pm that evening. Kids can also write him letters at the art center and at Plimoth Cinema.
Is there a Polar Express event in Plymouth?

Yes. The Plymouth Center for the Arts at 11 North Street holds a Polar Express evening in early December. Kids make an ornament, write a letter to Santa and enjoy cocoa and cookies while a conductor reads the story. Tickets are $10 through the art center, and seats are limited.
Can we take the train to Plymouth?

The nearest commuter rail stop is Kingston station, the end of the MBTA Kingston Line from South Station, in the town just north of Plymouth. The old Plymouth station closed in 2021, so families finish the trip downtown by car or rideshare. Edaville's holiday train is in Carver, next door.
